unresolved_blockers: Confirmed deterministic-vacuum defect: a geometric edge tangent can be returned as an EXIT before any air-set entry, terminating the path and losing one sample. The 128x128 constant-vacuum cohort exhibits 15 pixel/seed occurrences at4096SPP. Both Output-only recovery prototypes were rejected; production remains unchanged.
Entry-first contact and finite sub-epsilon boundary intervals are not certified by the current cohorts. Mean equivalence cannot override this known traversal defect.

addenda.provenance_class: parent pre-frozen + child launch capture; outer split-driver guard absent
addenda.limitation: No per-job before/after outer-driver guard for Primary was present in the executed split engine plan. These supplementary records establish parent pre-freeze and recorded child launch identity plus current equality; they do not retroactively create continuous runtime guarding.

runtime_provenance.limitation: A supplemental pre-freeze/launch/current match does not establish a per-job outer before/after guard or continuous runtime guarding.

scope.estimand: Per-pixel ratio of medium run mean to same-backend vacuum run mean, then fixed-region RGB/Y mean; no brightness fitting.
scope.uncertainty: Whole seed-pair bootstrap with prefixes paired; independent backends. Union with jackknife pseudo-value Welch-t95. Depth tails paired by seed. Four runs, nonlinear finite-ratio bias and non-simultaneous regional intervals remain.
scope.variance: ddof1 raw and fixed-high-SPP-vacuum-normalized pixel/run-region variance. Shared vacuum denominator preserves SPP comparisons. No equal-noise requirement.
scope.timing: Exact per-run scope strings preserved. Process/checkpoint timers are unlike and may overlap other work; no GPU-only or cross-renderer slowdown assertion.
scope.radiometry: v2 same flat spectrum shape and explicit scales; ratios cancel common source-defined white conversion only.
scope.acceptance: Scoped engineering bands, not proof of unbiasedness. stage_pass is always false; user visual/stage gate is separate.
